notes: Pure public-API Annex C.8 witnesses use adapter-owned schema-valid FOM modules to compare equivalent, conflicting, and omitted Advisories Use Known Class settings. The native duplicate and switch-default preflight cases passed 2/2. Equal and conflicting cases passed installed-package CTest/direct 8/8 each; the omitted case separately passed focused installed-package relink CTest/direct 4/4 each across both callback models without rebuilding unrelated objects. Java parity compiles against the API-only JAR, and three focused packaged Umbra JNI runtime scenarios passed (out/java-tck/advisory-switch-duplicate-equal-jni-20261021.json, advisory-switch-duplicate-order-jni-20261021.json, and advisory-switch-duplicate-omitted-jni-20261021.json). The portable cases assert only public Create, joined getAdvisoriesUseKnownClassSwitch, Resign, and Destroy outcomes. Other Java providers, private warnings, callback delivery policy, interoperability, and conformance are not claimed.
